parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the neuropeptide S receptor (CHEMBL5162). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join activities to assays on assay_id, join assays to target_dictionary on tid, and join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter where target chembl_id equals CHEMBL5162 and assay organism equals Homo sapiens. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
